title: Teachers Shape Our Future, Deserve Better Welfare, Says NDC Candidate Kehinde
summary: On World Teachers' Day 2026, Oluwadara Kehinde felicitates teachers across Yewa North/Imeko-Afon and Nigeria, calling them critical nation builders and urging better welfare, tools, professional development and investment in education, especially for rural teachers.

title: World Teachers’ Day: Obi says the dignity of teachers must be restored
summary: Peter Obi marks World Teachers’ Day, stressing teacher welfare and quality education.
